name: Talewyn Harbor
summary: Talewyn Harbor is a free-to-play multiplayer browser game set in a persistent coastal world. Players can fish, explore, sail, dive, gather resources, mine, cook, farm, craft, complete quests, tame and breed horses, and build and develop homesteads. The game features character progression, equipment upgrades, trading, multiplayer chat, changing weather and seasons, and a variety of activities and locations to discover. Talewyn Harbor can be played directly in a web browser without a download.
